_comment: Editorial illustrations for content pages. Prompts live here, not in the page,
so an image can be regenerated byte-for-byte from (prompt, seed, model).
The style is fixed: the site is printed on warm ivory paper with one ink colour,
and a photograph or a glossy render would look pasted in.
No text in the prompt on purpose — image models draw garbage lettering, and every
label that matters is set as live HTML next to the figure.
